entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ali Krasniqi was a Kosovar Roma writer and activist, who came to prominence at the start of the Kosovo War. He was born in Caravadicë, Obiliq, Yugoslavia. He wrote in the Kurbet dialect. Krasniqi died on 3 December 2024, at the age of 72.
